text: The specification and five OpenSpec capabilities are written. Drift reported no configured schematic and was only vacuously clean. I will reconcile the document obligations and submit stage 1 to its normal completion gate. Actual unloaded-current and BOM compliance remain UNKNOWN; downstream checks and all physical validation remain pending.

args.decision: Keep an efficient red LED with 10 kohm 1% series resistance as an ASSUMED starting choice, not a selected or visibility-qualified component.
args.rationale: The conservative 0.531 mA ceiling supports current planning, but acceptable indication at minimum input still requires actual-part evidence and physical review.

args.decision: Use ASSUMED initial defaults of a rectangular 40 x 30 mm hole-free prototype for dry indoor 0-50 degrees C bench use, without enclosure or coating.
args.rationale: These explicit provisional defaults make layout and worst-case review actionable without inventing enclosure or environmental qualification requirements.

args.decision: Treat outputs as load-only and unregulated, tracking input minus circuit losses; do not claim reverse-current blocking or permit external output powering under the ASSUMED operating contract.
args.rationale: The brief provides no voltage conversion or verified reverse-power protection, so those capabilities must not be implied.

args.summary: Seeded docs/SPEC.md with substantive budgets, original requirements, ASSUMED defaults, one-line rationales, supplied-source provenance, and explicit open acceptance questions; added five OpenSpec capabilities with Given/When/Then scenarios and recorded all stated budgets/constraints and non-trivial decisions. Document-revisit resolutions reconcile the seeded text only. The 1.791 mA sum is a provisional allocation, not verified worst-case compliance; actual unloaded-current and complete BOM compliance remain UNKNOWN pending downstream evidence. check_drift reported no schematic configured and vacuous cleanliness; no schematic/PCB or hardware verification is claimed. Firmware is NOT APPLICABLE at requirements level, with the genuine later stage outcome preserved. All eight pipeline stages/gates remain required. No prototype has been manufactured or physically tested; physical bring-up remains pending.
